import pytest
from my_application import AlarmSystem, set_threshold, compute_alarm

@pytest.mark.parametrize("threshold_value, min_threshold, max_threshold, expected", [
    ("above_threshold_value", "min_value", "max_value", "Threshold is set within the specified range."),
    ("out_of_range_value", "min_value", "max_value", "Threshold is not set within the specified range."),
    ("above_threshold_value", "above_threshold_value", "above_threshold_value", "LOW VTI alarm is active"),
    ("out_of_range_value", "above_threshold_value", "out_of_range_value", "LOW VTI alarm is not active"),
    # Add more parameters as needed for additional test cases
])
def test_alarm_threshold_setting(threshold_value, min_threshold, max_threshold, expected):
    AlarmSystem.set_threshold(threshold_value)
    result = compute_alarm("VTI")
    assert result == expected

@pytest.mark.parametrize("threshold_value, expected", [
    ("above_threshold_value", "LOW VTE alarm is active"),
    ("out_of_range_value", "LOW VTE alarm is not active"),

])
def test_low_vte_alarm_computation(threshold_value, expected):
